mutations.name: remove-expected-revision-guard
mutations.before: if ((previous?.revision ?? 0) !== input.expectedRevision) throw Object.assign(new Error(`事项版本冲突；当前版本 ${previous?.revision ?? 0}，请重读后再决定`), { code: 'DECISION_REVISION_CONFLICT', status: 409 });
